start.text: Dangling from a nail in the wall is what appears to be someone's failed craft project: three rusty nails knotted to a length of leather strap. A small scrap of parchment is attached. It reads: 'DO NOT TOUCH â€” Bertram'. Bertram is nowhere to be seen.

take.text: You give it a test swing. One of the nails immediately embeds itself in the wall. You wrench it free. It'll do.
